shortcuts.action: Open the session of the step that needs you (else the running or start step); on a graph, run it with its input

commands.title: List agent graphs
commands.description: List the agent graphs in .clubmate/graphs/*.json of your worktree (else of the workspace's folders), the graphs built into Clubmate (builtin: true; a project file with the same name replaces one) and this workspace's graph runs: {graphs: [{name, title?, description?, path, nodes, builtin?, error?}], runs: [{id, graph, title, status, reason?, turns, maxTurns, startedAt}]}. A graph whose file is invalid has error set. Non-destructive.

commands.title: Run agent graph
commands.description: Start a run of the agent graph .clubmate/graphs/<graph>.json, else of the built-in graph <graph> (see graphs.list): one idle agent session per node (your child sessions when you call it), one trigger per edge (on the source node's turn end or reported outcome, prompt the target node), then the start nodes get their prompt with input. The run stops itself when a node reports an outcome listed in its end, after the graph's maxTurns turns (default 20) or when your session closes; graphs.stop stops it earlier. Sessions stay open after a run stops. Returns the run: {id, graph, title, builtin?, status, turns, maxTurns, nodes: [{id, role, start?, session}], edges: [{from, to, on, outcome?, trigger}]}. Watch nodes with agents.wait on their sessions. Non-destructive.

graph.description: Graph name: the file name in .clubmate/graphs/ without .json, e.g. review-loop.

input.description: Task for the run, filled into {{input}} of the node prompts or appended to the start nodes' prompt; must not contain {{.

commands.title: Show agent graph run
commands.description: Show one graph run with each node's session title and live status (running, waiting, done, idle, error, closed, gone): {id, graph, title, status, reason?, input?, turns, maxTurns, startedAt, stoppedAt?, nodes: [{id, role, start?, session, title?, status}], edges: [{from, to, on, outcome?, trigger}]}. Non-destructive.

commands.title: Stop agent graph run
commands.description: Stop a graph run: delete its edge triggers so no node prompts another. Running turns go on and the sessions stay open; cancel their turns with agents.cancel. An agent may stop only runs started by itself or its child sessions. Returns the run. Non-destructive.

commands.title: Open agent graph run
commands.description: Select the run in the Graphs section and focus its detail; Triggers calls it for Open graph on a trigger a run created.

commands.title: Remove agent graph run
commands.description: Stop a graph run like graphs.stop and remove it from the list. The sessions stay open. An agent may remove only runs started by itself or its child sessions. Non-destructive.
